notes: Race/ethnicity is compared as the composition of decedents vs survivors, with no test and no per-group death rate, so no groupwise entry (composition rule). The worldwide rate of 1.2 per 1,000 is cited, not computed. JYNNEOS receipt appears in Table 1 but is not analyzed.
view_issues: Table 1 lists 'Yes, other immunocompromising conditions' for decedents as 2 (9.1%), which conflicts with 33 decedents having known status (2/33 = 6.1%); its HIV percentages sum to more than 100%. In Table 1 the JYNNEOS 'Yes' rows (72.8%, 7.7%) look inconsistent with the totals.
